drive car1 jwalamukhi-shelter tadi-farm
load car1 adult 2
drive car1 tadi-farm jwalamukhi-shelter

drive car2 gosaikunda-hospital galchhi-farm
load car2 elderly 2

load car2 adult 1
drive car2 dupcheshwar-market kakani-village
drive car2 kakani-village gosaikunda-hospital
unload car2 adult 4
drive car2 gosaikunda-hospital kakani-village
drive car2 kakani-village dupcheshwar-market
load car2 adult 4
drive car2 dupcheshwar-market kakani-village
drive car2 kakani-village gosaikunda-hospital
unload car2 adult 4
defer dupcheshwar-market adult 1
</plan>
COST: 212

Assumptions and notes:
- Roads are two-way. Only Jwalamukhi shelter and Gosaikunda hospital are evacuation points, so every rescued person is dropped at one of them.
- Shopkeepers, labourers and cooperative members are adults; the two pensioners are elderly.
- Driving totals: car1 10 min (Tadi), car2 86 min (Galchhi round trip) + 96 min (two Dupcheshwar runs via Kakani) = 192 min. Deferral penalty: 1 adult × 20 = 20. Total 212.
- One adult at Dupcheshwar is deferred. A third run to collect that person would cost 48 minutes to save a 20-minute penalty, so it isn't worth it.
- Rescuing the two elderly at Galchhi costs 86 minutes against a 100-minute penalty for deferring them, so the rescue is the cheaper option.
